item.title: 【UPSCALED】Charli XCX - You (Ha Ha Ha) [4K AI Upscale|AVC|MKV|5.1 Dolby Digital Plus]
item.description:
The video for "You (Ha Ha Ha)" was uploaded to her channel on YouTube on January 10th 2013, and was directed by Ryan Andrews like all of the videos for the True Romance era (excluding "You're the One"). The controversial video finds Charli loading gun shells in a firearms factory and trading the lead tips for lipstick. It's release couldn't have been timed any worse coming just weeks after the Newtown, Connecticut, shooting. The singer issued a response saying in part, "The idea is to make lipstick, not war, but I'd like to say sorry if anyone has mistaken this video for advocating violence."

Ripped from youtube then upscaled with Topaz Video and Mixed into 5.1 by me using ffmpeg.
